description: Source file for FreeType library providing utility functions for PostScript font support, including font info retrieval, glyph name support, private font data, and font value extraction.

methods.name: FT_Get_PS_Font_Info
methods.description: Retrieves PostScript font information for a given font face.

methods.name: FT_Has_PS_Glyph_Names
methods.description: Checks if the font face has PostScript glyph names.

methods.name: FT_Get_PS_Font_Private
methods.description: Retrieves private font data for a given font face.

methods.name: FT_Get_PS_Font_Value
methods.description: Gets a specific font value from the font's dictionary.
